I am farming my small maize plot here in Dedza, and I hope to get a FISP coupon this year like many of my neighbours — without it, fertilizer is too dear for me. If I get the coupon, I will put the NPK and urea on this small plot because maize without fertilizer gives almost nothing on our tired soil. I have no schooling and no husband's wage, so I cannot afford hybrid seed on my own; I will plant seed I kept from last season. I will weed by hand myself, maybe with help from my sister, and I cannot afford pesticide or to hire ganyu workers.
